definitions.business_date: order (or refund) timestamp converted to America/New_York, date part
definitions.revenue_cents: item subtotal of sales minus refunds; excludes shipping, tax and fees
definitions.fees_cents: marketplace fees on sales, reported separately (refunds carry no fee in this data)
definitions.customers: distinct buyer usernames; Amazon has no buyer id so it counts orders
definitions.enterprise.customers: sum of per-marketplace counts (buyers can't be matched across marketplaces)
definitions.status: ok = rows for that day, stale = file present but no rows that day, missing = no file

mess: No Cash Monkey file: eBay and Amazon must both show as missing, never $0.
formats: Upright Paid orders (.xlsx, Pacific, one row per order) and Cash Monkey Orders Report (.xlsx, UTC, one line per unit); see data/README.md
